title: worldparts system document (0.1)
description: Language-neutral description of a composed worldparts system (docs/design.md section 6.3). Values are numbers in the component's declared unit, strings with units (e.g. '3.5 bar'), booleans, enum strings or tables (lists of rows; each cell a number in the declared column unit or a string with a unit). A component may also carry state values (for example a tank level) under states.

controls.description: Control loops (docs/design.md section 13.1): each reads one reported numeric variable and writes one numeric component input.

type.description: Full component id or short alias.

states.description: Optional state values (declared units), applied after parameters and inputs.

oneOf.description: Ramp values linearly from [start, end] between 'at' and 'at' + 'over' (one set event per step; docs/design.md section 13.2).

switch_state.description: 'on' or 'off' (YAML reads a bare on/off as a boolean, which is accepted).

measure.description: Any reported numeric path, e.g. pump.outlet.p.

actuate.description: A numeric input of a component, e.g. pump.speed.

setpoint.description: pi: in the measured variable's unit, or a string with units.

gain.description: pi: actuator units per measured unit (positive).

integral_time.description: pi: seconds or a string such as '10 s'.

output_min.description: pi: lower output limit (default: the input's hard limit).

output_max.description: pi: upper output limit (default: the input's hard limit).

direction.description: pi: reverse (default) raises the output when the measure is below the setpoint.

on_below.description: hysteresis: switch on when the measure falls below this.

off_above.description: hysteresis: switch off when the measure rises above this.

initial.description: hysteresis: the state at creation (default off).

state.description: hysteresis: the current state, written when it differs from initial.
